description: Adds a note (IModelDoc2.InsertNote): on a sheet, or in a view, with a leader to a model entity the view shows when attach_to names one (a ViewEntity selected through its view, never picked by sheet coordinates), its text placed at at (sheet mm). text may link properties: $PRP:"Title" shows the drawing's Title (drawing.properties writes them), and shown gives the text as resolved. Checked: the note is on the sheet or in the view asked, its text reads back as written, its position within 0.01 mm, and its leader is attached to that entity; the model is unchanged. An entity the view does not show is refused naming the view and the entity. Otherwise the note is deleted again (rolled back).

document.description: The drawing: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

text.description: The note's text; $PRP:"name" links a property of the drawing.

x.description: Mm to the right of the sheet's lower-left corner.

y.description: Mm above the sheet's lower-left corner.

at.description: Where its text goes, sheet mm from the sheet's lower-left corner.

view.description: The view: a reference (r1.view.…) or its name (Drawing View1).

reference.description: A reference issued in the view's model (model.find, view.entities), alone. One of reference or entity.

component.description: With entity in an assembly view: the component, by reference or name; entity is then a reference issued in the component's own part, or a name there.

entity.description: A name in the view's model (Boss-Extrude1, front, Axis1@pin-1), or with component an entity of that component. One of reference or entity.

attach_to.description: The model entity its leader points at, as a view shows it: an edge, vertex or face. The note goes into that view.

view.description: The view the note goes into (a reference or a name), without a leader unless attach_to is given (then it must be attach_to's view). On the sheet itself when view and attach_to are absent.

sheet.description: The sheet for a note on a sheet itself (a reference or a name); the sheet shown when absent. With view or attach_to, it must be that view's sheet.
